incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: service=redwood-inference-p99 | severity=P1 | condition=p99 > 1.2s for 3m. runbook: /runbooks/latency-burn. PD: https://pagerduty.example/INC-98765
anya: ack — I'm the primary oncall, taking initial triage
jake: oncall here, reachable. pulling dashboards and traces now
kumar: seeing spike localized to eu-west-2. throughput steady but tail latency climbing fast
olivia: p50 ~ 80ms, p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 1300ms. KV-cache eviction events start at 12:13:20 UTC. logs: https://logs.redwood/trace/xyz
anya: quick question — any recent deploys to eu-west?
melissa: no deploys in last 2hr from release pipeline, infra autoscaler did a few node drains earlier this morning
anya: mitigation plan: 1) route sensitive traffic off eu-west for 5m 2) warm fallback model variant 3) if no improvement, enable throttle on batcher
jake: confirm routing override command?
anya: running: `redwood route override --service=inference --from-region=eu-west-2 --to-region=us-west-1 --percent=60 --temporary` (will revert after 10m)
incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-98765 acknowledged by anya
kumar: starting kv warm on affected pods: `kubectl exec -n inference -it pod/sidecar-abc -- /opt/warm_kv.sh --keys 10000`
olivia: notifying CS/Support: sending short note — estimated impact <5% customers, elevated latency only, no increased 5xxs
melissa: I'll keep an eye on autoscaler logs — possible eviction loop triggering sidecar thrash
anya: routing override applied. monitoring p99
anya: update 30s — p99 dropped from ~1300ms to ~480ms. p95 back to normal-ish
jake: good signal. I'll prepare fallback model rollout: enabling variant `inference-v2-q4-lite` for latency routes (gradual 10% -> 50%)
kumar: warming looks successful, sidecar memory stable now. eviction count decreased
olivia: CS acked the note and will wait for final resolution before sending customer follow-up
anya: plan for 10m stabilization, then drain and restart a few eu-west nodes gracefully to break any latent state
melissa: confirming no new deploy and infra jobs queued. Looks safe to drain two nodes sequentially
jake: if we see another spike after drains, enact plan B: reduce batch size `BATCHER_MAX_TOKENS=16` and promote quantized model globally
anya: agreed. handing off if still active after my shift. melissa, you'll be next rotation, right?
melissa: correct — I'll take over if it persists. document steps and link runbook in the incident ticket
incident-bot: PD INC-98765 status: acknowledged -> monitoring. next automated check in 5m
anya: quick post-incident notes: likely cause = cache eviction + regional resource pressure causing tails. Actions taken = routing override, kv warm, node drains planned, fallback variant prepared. Customer impact = brief p99 spike, <1% requests >2s, no 5xxs. Follow-up: postmortem and alert threshold tweak (raise p99 auto-runbook trigger to require sustained 5m with correlating evictions)
jake: adding alert tuning and a small dashboard widget for eviction->latency correlation
melissa: will schedule 1:1 with infra to review node eviction policy
anya: thanks all. marking thread for handoff. :thumbsup:
